verdict.rationale: Online filing or payment is a fair question for a state tax agency, so the axis applies. However, both probes hit Akamai 403 walls at www.ftb.ca.gov and webapp.ftb.ca.gov, so none of the service's own published pages were read. The probe's passing reference to MyFTB and Web Pay is a label in the pipeline's note, not documentation fetched from the service, so it cannot show the core transaction can be completed online. This is absence of evidence, not proof the capability is missing, which is why confidence is low.
